home.description: EthioHelp AI helps the Ethiopian community get accurate, step-by-step information about government services, education, health, jobs, and business processes - all powered by AI.
home.features_title: What can EthioHelp AI help you with?
home.features_subtitle: Ask questions about any of these topics and get accurate, sourced answers.
home.feat_gov_desc: Get help with passports, IDs, licenses, and other official documents.
home.feat_edu_desc: Learn about university applications, scholarships, and enrollment.
home.feat_health_desc: Find information on healthcare services and medical procedures.
home.feat_jobs_desc: Discover how to start a business, register, or find employment.
home.how_1_desc: Admins upload documents about Ethiopian services and processes to build the knowledge base.
home.how_2_desc: Users type their question in the chat. The AI searches the knowledge base for relevant information.
home.how_3_desc: The AI provides sourced, step-by-step answers based only on verified documents.
footer.text: EthioHelp AI - Helping the Ethiopian community with accurate information.
chat.ask_subtitle: Ask any question about Ethiopian government services, education, health, jobs, or business processes. Try something like:

chat.suggestion_3: What documents are needed to start a business?
